title: Scenario catalog: the behaviours of one eShop module
description: One file per module, named <module>.scenarios.json, where <module> is an id in test-tooling/modules.json. pnpm check:scenarios validates every catalog against this schema. See docs/scenario-catalog.md.

$schema.description: Optional. "./scenario.schema.json" lets an editor check the file as you type.

module.description: The module's id in test-tooling/modules.json; the same as the file name before .scenarios.json.

prefix.description: The module's prefix in test-tooling/modules.json: 2 to 4 capital letters that start every id in this file.

scenarios.description: The rows. Retired rows stay, so their ids are never reused.

id.description: <PREFIX>-<GROUP>-<SLUG> in capitals, e.g. CAT-READ-FILTER-NAME-PREFIX. Permanent: never renamed, never reused.

behaviour.description: One sentence, present tense: what eShop does, observable by a user or caller.

screens.description: Screen ids from test-tooling/inventory/screens.json (<app>:<route>) where the behaviour is seen. Naming one makes the row owe a UI test. May be empty.

endpoints.description: Endpoint ids from test-tooling/inventory/endpoints.json (METHOD /path) whose contract the behaviour is. Naming one makes the row owe an API test. May be empty.

kind.description: happy: the normal path. error: eShop refuses or reports a problem. edge: a boundary or unusual case. regression: a bug that came back once.

source.description: Where the row came from: screen (reading a page), business-rule (a rule in eShop's code), bug, new-feature, or existing-test (written from a test that already checks it).

sourceNote.description: Free text for the next reader: an eShop file:line, an issue link, or the test. Nothing checks it.

status.description: active, or retired when the behaviour is gone (the row stays so its id is never reused).

added.description: The day the row was written, YYYY-MM-DD.

changed.description: The day the row last changed, YYYY-MM-DD. Equal to added for a new row; never before it.
